# Epic Template

## Summary

Brief description of the epic and why it exists.

## Problem

What user or system problem this epic solves.

## Outcome

The measurable result expected when the epic is complete.

## Scope

### In scope

List the work included in this epic.

### Out of scope

List what is explicitly not included.

## Related docs

Link to vision, principles, architecture, and any relevant existing feature docs.

## Success criteria

Describe what must be true for the epic to be considered successful.

## Dependencies

List required technical or product dependencies.

## Risks / open questions

Record unresolved questions and known risks before implementation starts.
